scope: Supplier statements and unresolved procurement; NO measured lot properties

motor.mass_basis: manufacturer product nominal, not measured; COM/inertia unknown
motor.limit: Holding torque is NOT running or continuous allowable torque. Older S (without S1) torque curve not transferred.

rail.limit: Supplier notes modulus lowers with cold work; no full-hard modulus or actual 0.20 mm lot certificate. 193 GPa only a model sensitivity input, NOT a certified lower bound.

shaft.limit: Typical properties, not lot minimum or fatigue allowable; not a hole stress concentration qualification.

wire.limit: 0.50 mm not listed for this construction in inspected current table; custom supply may exist, must confirm. DO NOT interpolate certified breaking load or linear mass. 1x19 0.50 mm is a different construction. NI000032 swage pullout and axial EA not given here.

PET.limit: Generic PET sheet on BOM; no selected grade/lot or guaranteed modulus/yield/creep. Parameter studies must be labeled assumed sensitivity, not procurement bounds.
